# Elite Biomedical Services

> Elite Biomedical Services is a respiratory care and biomedical equipment provider based in Edodi, Vadakara, Kozhikode, Kerala. The business primarily serves Vadakara and nearby North Kerala districts including Kozhikode, Kannur, Wayanad, and Malappuram with oxygen concentrator sales, service, installation, CPAP and BiPAP support, home sleep study support, and respiratory care guidance.
